a.clean: Thoughts after the fantasy league meeting, first of all the commissioner wants to change the playoff format from four teams to six, which I think is fine as long as the byes go to the top two seeds. Also, Calani brought up the idea of a keeper rule where each manager can hold onto two players from year to year, and I actually like that one a lot, but we need to decide how to handle the draft round penalty and weather.
